question: What is the range (max minus min) of total quarterly revenue (summing all three product lines) across the four quarters?
description: Tier A / presentation-only attack: the y-axis top is set to 600, far past the true max stack total (~310), compressing all four bars' true 70/240 (~29%) range into the bottom half of the plot. Axis ticks are accurate for the widened range; stack order, data, and tooltips are unchanged. Technique: 'inappropriate_axis_range' (Misleading ChartQA arXiv:2503.18172, 'Manipulated Scale' category). Plotly computes stacking internally from the underlying data regardless of the y-axis view range, so (unlike d3's imperative pixel math) there's no risk of a floor-truncation version clipping segments -- wide-range was kept for cross-library technique parity with d3/chartjs/vega-lite, not because it was the only safe option here. True range is 70 (310-240); the compressed scale may bias a vision-reading model toward underestimating it.
